MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 9 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 19
   C. 9
   D. 11

2. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

4. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 17
   D. 73

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 31
   C. 41
   D. 49

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 36

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

8. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

9. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 48
   C. 2
   D. 49

10. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 57
   C. 15
   D. 56

11. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 25

12. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 3
   C. 13
   D. 41

13. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

14. Solve for x: x + 6 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 14
   C. 8
   D. 9

15. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

16. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

17. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 0
   C. 64
   D. 16

18. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

19. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 12

20. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

21. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

22. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

23. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

24. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
